sources.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA 这篇博客讲 Microduck 的 Sim2Real 避障流程：固定原行走策略权重，用 Newton raycaster 建模 ToF 传感，在 Isaac Lab 以 50 Hz 训练独立控制器调整 gamepad 速度指令，并覆盖训练、评估、导出和真机部署。

en.reason: Microduck's Sim2Real obstacle-avoidance workflow keeps the original walking policy fixed, models ToF sensing with Newton's raycaster, and trains an independent 50 Hz Isaac Lab controller to adjust gamepad velocity commands, covering training, evaluation, export, and real-robot deployment.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 亚马逊 Strands Agents 团队开源 Strands Decider v2 系列五款模型（E2B 至 31B），基于 Google Gemma4 架构、用 1750 万条高质量样本训练，采用 Apache-2.0 许可，权重已上架 Hugging Face。

items.title_original: 关闭浏览器仍狂吃数百兆内存！Chrome隐藏的“AI内存刺客”被揪出，一招教你彻底释放资源
items.recommend_reason_zh: 开发者通过新建未登录配置文件交叉测试发现，关闭Chrome后多个进程仍占用300MB到700MB内存，元凶是内置Gemini AI为随时快捷键召唤而保留后台进程。

en.title: Closing the browser doesn't stop it from eating hundreds of megabytes of RAM! Chrome's hidden "AI memory assassin" has been exposed — here's one trick to free up those resources for good
en.reason: Chrome can keep several processes holding 300MB to 700MB of memory after the browser window is closed, and this piece traces that behavior to the built-in Gemini AI keeping background processes alive for instant shortcut access, verified through cross-testing with fresh, signed-out profiles.

sources.title_original: 拒绝“AI 垃圾代码”！LibreOffice 祭出最严 AI 编程新规：用大模型写代码，必须先过“人工解释”关
sources.recommend_reason_zh: LibreOffice 维护方 TDF 为 LLM 辅助编程设四条硬规：AI 补丁须用自己话解释每一行修改代码，提交前获批并披露，且禁用 LLM 写提交信息、注释。

en.title: No "AI junk code": LibreOffice unveils its strictest AI coding rules yet — use an LLM to write code and you must first pass a human explanation checkpoint
en.reason: LibreOffice maintainer TDF sets four hard rules for LLM-assisted coding: AI patches must explain every changed line in the contributor’s own words, win approval and disclosure before submission, and cannot use LLMs for commit messages or comments.

en.title: How Uber Evaluates More Than a Million Agent Skill Invocations a Month
en.summary: With more and more Skills being written, how do you know which ones are actually useful and which are just burning extra tokens? Uber’s Skill library has surpassed 5,000, with over a million invocations a month. This engineering retrospective shares their management approach.
en.reason: Uber’s internal skill library grew from 1 to over 5,000 skills in a year and now sees more than a million agent skill calls a month, and this engineering retrospective details how Git repositories and three-stage SKILL.md loading manage quality, efficiency and distribution.

sources.summary: WaytoAGI、ACE-CON 与剪映联合呈现的AI x 音乐视觉黑客松，让 38 支队伍在4小时内完成创作，最终8支作品与乐队同台共演。这篇回顾文章也拆解了现场的创作方法：保留满意片段继续生成、用低清样片试剪、用 Skill 统一视觉规范，再精修卡点与音效。做 MV、演出视觉或 AI 视频的朋友，可以看看创作者如何把零散的漂亮镜头，做成真正服务音乐的作品！
